description_zh: 创建一个 Redis开源版经典架构、Redis开源版云原生架构、Tair内存型经典架构实例。若要创建云原生架构的Tair实例，请使用CreateTairInstance接口

name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: token

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance. The name must be 2 to 80 characters in length, and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot contain the following special characters: `@/:=”<>{[]}` and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称。 名称为2~80个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，不支持字符`@/:=”<>{[]}`和空格
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the instance. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, special characters, and digits. The allowed special characters include `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.help_zh: 实例密码。 长度为8－32位，需包含大写字母、小写字母、特殊字符和数字中的至少三种，允许的特殊字符包括`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity of the instance. Unit: MB.

When you call this operation, you must specify at least one of the Capacity and InstanceClass parameters
parameters.help_zh:
实例的存储容量，单位为MB。

调用此接口需至少传递Capacity或InstanceClass中的一个参数
parameters.name: capacity

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. For example, redis.master.small.default indicates a 1 GB Community Edition (classic architecture) instance with the standard architecture and two replicas. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html. 

When you call this operation, you must specify at least one of the Capacity and InstanceClass parameters
parameters.help_zh:
实例的规格，例如redis.master.small.default为社区版（经典版）标准架构双副本1GB实例，详细信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html。 

调用此接口需至少传递Capacity或InstanceClass中的一个参数
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The primary active zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent active zone list, and use this parameter to specify the active zone where you want to create the instance.
You can also specify the SecondaryZoneId parameter to set the secondary active zone. The deployment of the primary and secondary nodes is in the specified primary and secondary active zones to implement a primary/secondary architecture. For example, you can set the ZoneId parameter to "cn-hangzhou-h" and the SecondaryZoneId parameter to "cn-hangzhou-g"
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的可用区。
您也可以再传入SecondaryZoneId参数指定备可用区，主备节点将分别部署在指定的主可用区和备可用区，实现同城双中心主备架构。例如指定ZoneId参数为"cn-hangzhou-h"，指定SecondaryZoneId参数为"cn-hangzhou-g"
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473764.html operation to query the most recent zone list.
The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the ZoneId parameter, and cannot be the ID of a multi-zone deployment
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473764.html接口查询。
本参数和ZoneId参数传入的值不能相同，且不可传入多可用区对应的ID
parameters.name: secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid (default): pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值：
PrePaid：预付费。
PostPaid（默认）：按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:
MASTER_SLAVE: high-availability (two replicas)
STAND_ALONE: single replica
double: two replicas
single: single replica
For cloud-native instances, select MASTER_SLAVE or STAND_ALONE. For classic instances, select double or single
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，取值：
MASTER_SLAVE：高可用（双副本）
STAND_ALONE：单副本
double：双副本
single：单副本
云原生版实例请选择MASTER_SLAVE或STAND_ALONE，经典版实例请选择double或single
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type. Valid values:
VPC: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC). This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
网络类型，取值：
VPC：专有网络，默认值
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC
parameters.help_zh: VPC网络的ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机的ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, 36, and 60.

This parameter is required and takes effect only when the ChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
付费周期，单位为月，取值：1~9、12、24、36、60  。

ChargeType取值为PrePaid时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The ID of the promotional event or business information
parameters.help_zh: 活动ID、业务信息
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. Default value: `default`
parameters.help_zh: 优惠码，默认值为：`default`
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
If you want to create a new instance based on the backup set of an instance, specify the source instance ID in this parameter first.
Then, specify the backup set or point in time by using the BackupId, ClusterBackupId (recommended for cloud-native cluster architecture), or RestoreTime parameter. This parameter must be used in combination with one of the preceding three parameters
parameters.help_zh:
如需基于某个实例的备份集创建新实例，请先在此参数中指定源实例ID。
然后通过BackupId、ClusterBackupId（云原生集群架构建议使用ClusterBackupId）或RestoreTime参数指定需要使用的备份集或指定时间点，本参数需要与上述3个中的任意一个参数组合使用
parameters.name: src_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
You can specify the backup set ID of the source instance in this parameter. The system uses the data saved in the backup set to create the new instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html operation to query the BackupId. If the source instance is a cluster instance, you must enter the backup set IDs of all shards in the source instance and separate them with commas, such as "10,11,15**".
If your instance is a cloud-native architecture instance and a cluster instance, we recommend that you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679168.html operation to query the cluster backup set ID, such as "cb-xx", and then enter it in the ClusterBackupId request parameter to clone the cluster instance. This saves you the trouble of entering the backup set ID of each shard
parameters.help_zh:
您可在此参数中指定源实例的备份集ID，系统将使用该备份集中保存的数据创建新实例。通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html可查询BackupId。如果源实例是集群实例，则此处需要填写源实例各个分片的备份集id，并且通过逗号隔开，例如"10**,11**,15**"。
若您的实例是云原生架构实例，并且是集群实例，则建议您使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679168.html查询出集群备份集id，例如"cb-xx"，然后填入ClusterBackupId请求参数来达到克隆集群实例的目的，免去您输入各个分片备份集id的烦恼
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:
Redis (default)
Memcache
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值：
Redis（默认）
Memcache
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The engine version of the Redis classic instance. Valid values:
2.8 (Not recommended. https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2674657.html.)
4.0 (Not recommended)
5.0

The engine version of the Redis cloud-native instance. Valid values:
5.0
6.0 (Recommended)
7.0

Default value: 5.0
parameters.help_zh:
Redis经典版本，版本号取值：
2.8（不推荐，https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2674657.html）
4.0（不推荐）
5.0

Redis云原生版本，版本号取值：
5.0
6.0（推荐）
7.0

默认值为5.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The internal network IP address of the new instance.

The internal network IP address must be within the vSwitch CIDR block to which the instance belongs
parameters.help_zh:
指定新实例的内网IP地址。

内网IP需在实例所属的交换机网段内
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a voucher. Valid values:
true: uses a voucher.
false (default): does not use a voucher
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券，取值：
true：使用代金券。
false（默认）：不使用代金券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal.
false (default): disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false（默认）：不开启
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal epoch. Unit: months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.

This parameter is required when the AutoRenew parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，取值：1、2、3、6、12。

当AutoRenew取值为true时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the source instance. If the data flashback feature is enabled for the source instance, you can specify any point in time within the backup retention period of the source instance. The system uses the backup data of the source instance at the specified point in time to create the new instance. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 若源实例已开启数据闪回，您可在此参数中指定源实例备份保留周期内的任意时间点，系统将使用源实例在该时间点的备份数据创建新实例。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster. This parameter is required when you create an ApsaraDB for Redis instance in a dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群ID，在专属集群内创建Redis实例时需传入本参数
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of shards. This parameter applies only to cloud-native instances. You can use this parameter to specify a custom number of shards.

1: creates a non-cluster architecture.
A value greater than 1: creates a cluster architecture
parameters.help_zh:
分片数，本参数仅适用于创建云原生版实例，您可以通过该参数实现自定义分片数量。

1代表创建非集群架构。
大于1代表创建集群架构
parameters.name: shard_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of secondary nodes in the primary zone. This parameter applies only to cloud-native cluster instances with multiple replicas. You can use this parameter to specify a custom number of secondary nodes. Valid values: 1 to 4.

If you create a multi-zone instance, you can use this parameter and the SlaveReplicaCount parameter to specify the number of secondary nodes in the primary and secondary zones. The sum of this parameter and the SlaveReplicaCount parameter cannot exceed 4
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区的备节点，本参数仅适用于创建云原生版集群多副本实例，您可以通过该参数实现自定义备节点数量，取值：1~4。

若创建多可用区实例，您可以通过该参数与SlaveReplicaCount参数自定义主、备可用区的备节点数量。同时，该参数与SlaveReplicaCount参数的总和不能超过4
parameters.name: replica_count

parameters.help_en: The number of secondary nodes in the secondary zone
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区的备节点数量
parameters.name: slave_replica_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of read-only nodes in the primary zone. This parameter applies only to cloud-native read/write splitting instances.
If the instance uses the standard architecture, valid values are 1 to 9.
If the instance uses the cluster architecture, valid values are 1 to 4, which indicates the number of read-only nodes per shard.
If you create a multi-zone instance, you can use this parameter and the SlaveReadOnlyCount parameter to specify the number of read-only nodes in the primary and secondary zones.
If the instance uses the standard architecture, the sum of this parameter and the SlaveReadOnlyCount parameter cannot exceed 9.
If the instance uses the cluster architecture, the sum of this parameter and the SlaveReadOnlyCount parameter cannot exceed 4
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区的只读节点数，本参数仅适用于创建云原生读写分离实例。
若实例为标准架构，取值为1~9。
若实例为集群架构，取值为1-4，表示每数据分片的只读节点数。
若创建多可用区实例，您可以通过该参数和SlaveReadOnlyCount参数自定义主备可用区的只读节点数量。
若实例为标准架构，该参数与SlaveReadOnlyCount的总和不能大于9。
若实例为集群架构，该参数与SlaveReadOnlyCount的总和不能大于4
parameters.name: read_only_count

parameters.help_en: The number of read-only nodes in the secondary zone
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区的只读节点数量
parameters.name: slave_read_only_count

parameters.help_en:
The distributed instance ID. This parameter applies only to the China site.

<props="china"> If you want to append the new ApsaraDB for Redis instance as a new child instance to a distributed instance, this parameter is active and required. For more information and console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/106885.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
分布式实例ID，本参数仅适用于中国站。

<props="china"> 如需将新创建的Redis实例追加为分布式实例中的新子实例，本参数才可用且必须传入。相关说明与控制台操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/106885.html。</props>
parameters.name: global_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the new instance as the first child instance of a distributed instance. You can create a distributed instance in this way. Valid values:

true: uses the new instance as the first child instance.
false (default): does not use the new instance as the first child instance.

If you set this parameter to true, the new instance must be a Tair memory-optimized instance and the DPI engine version must be 5.0.
This parameter applies only to the China site
parameters.help_zh:
是否将本次新建的实例作为分布式实例中的第一个子实例，通过该方式可创建分布实例，取值：

true：作为第一个子实例。
false（默认）：不作为第一个子实例。

如需传入true，本次新建的实例需为Tair内存型，引擎版本为5.0。
本参数仅适用于中国站
parameters.name: global_instance

parameters.help_en: The service port of the instance. Valid values: 1 to 65535. Default value: 6379
parameters.help_zh: 实例的服务端口，取值范围：1~65535，默认值为6379
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the instance creation request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without creating the instance. The system checks the request parameters, request format, service limits, and available resources. If the request fails the dry run, the system returns an error. If the request passes the dry run, the system returns the DryRunOperation error code.
false (default): sends the normal request and creates the instance after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次创建实例的操作执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查操作，不创建实例。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The global IP address whitelist templates of the instance. Separate multiple templates with commas (,). Duplicate templates are not allowed.
<notice>This parameter applies only to cloud-native instances. Classic instances do not support the whitelist template feature.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例的全局IP白名单模板，多个IP白名单模板请用英文逗号（,）分隔，不可重复。
<notice>该参数仅适用于云原生实例，经典版实例不支持白名单模板功能。></notice>
parameters.name: global_security_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The AOF parameter settings of the new instance. Valid values:
yes (default): enables AOF persistence.
no: shutdown AOF persistence.
This parameter applies to classic instances. Cloud-native instances do not support specifying the AOF parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建实例的AOF参数配置，取值：
yes（默认）：开启AOF持久化。
no：关闭AOF持久化。
该参数适用于经典版实例，云原生版实例暂不支持指定AOF参数
parameters.name: appendonly

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the endpoint. The prefix must be 8 to 40 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters and digits. It must start with a lowercase letter.


The endpoint format is: <Prefix>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址的前缀，需由小写英文字母与数字组成，以小写字母开头，长度为8~40个字符。


连接地址格式为：<前缀>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en: The globally unique ID of the parameter template.><notice>This parameter applies only to cloud-native instances.</notice>
parameters.help_zh: 参数模板ID，全局唯一。><notice>仅支持云原生实例></notice>
parameters.name: param_group_id

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag.

N indicates the sequence number of the tag key. You can attach up to 20 tags to a single instance. For example, Tag.1.Key indicates the key of the first tag, and Tag.2.Key indicates the key of the second tag.
If the key of the tag does not exist, the system performs automatic creation
fields.help_zh:
标签的键。

N表示传入第几个标签的键，单个实例最多可绑定20个标签。例如Tag.1.Key表示传入第一个标签的键；Tag.2.Key表示传入第二个标签的键。
如果标签的键不存在，则自动创建
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag.
N indicates the sequence number of the tag value. For example, Tag.1.Value indicates the value of the first tag, and Tag.2.Value indicates the value of the second tag
fields.help_zh:
标签的值。
N表示传入第几个标签的值。例如Tag.1.Value表示传入第一个标签的值；Tag.2.Value表示传入第二个标签的值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tag information of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster backup set. Some new cluster architectures support cluster backup set IDs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679168.html operation to obtain the ID.
If the architecture supports cluster backup sets, you can enter the specified cluster backup set ID without specifying the BackupId parameter.
If the architecture does not support cluster backup sets, specify the backup set IDs of all shards in the source instance in the BackupId parameter and separate them with commas, such as "2158\\20,2158\\22"
parameters.help_zh:
部分新集群架构支持集群备份集ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679168.html接口获取。
若支持，可输入指定的集群备份集ID即可，无需再填写BackupId参数。
若不支持，请在BackupId参数中填写为原实例各个分片下的备份集ID，通过逗号隔开，例如"2158\\20,2158\\22"等
parameters.name: cluster_backup_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restore the account, kernel parameters, and whitelist information from the original backup set when you create an instance by using a specified backup set. For example, to restore the account information, set the value to `account`.

Default value: empty, which indicates that the account, kernel parameters, and whitelist information are not restored from the original backup set.
This parameter applies only to cloud-native instances, and the original backup set must contain the account, kernel parameters, and whitelist information. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html operation to query whether the RecoverConfigMode parameter of the specified backup set contains the preceding information
parameters.help_zh:
使用指定备份集创建实例时，是否从原备份集中恢复账号（account）、内核参数（config）、白名单（whitelist）信息。例如需恢复账号信息，则取值为`account`。

默认为空，表示不从原备份集中恢复账号、内核参数、白名单信息。
本参数仅适用于云原生版实例，且需要原备份集中已保存了账号、内核参数、白名单信息。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html接口查询指定备份集中的RecoverConfigMode参数是否包含上述信息
parameters.name: recover_config_mode

parameters.help_en:
The type of the endpoint used when you create a cloud-native dual-zone deployment read/write splitting instance. If you do not explicitly specify this parameter, the default value is AzIndependentEndpoint.

AzIndependentEndpoint: Default value. Active zone-independent endpoints. The primary and secondary active zones provide independent endpoints. You can use different endpoints to implement nearest access for active zones.
UnifiedEndpoint: Unified endpoint. A unified endpoint is provided to access nodes in both the primary and secondary active zones, but cross-zone access may occur.

<notice>This parameter applies only to cloud-native dual-zone deployment read/write splitting instances. For other types of instances, only active zone-independent endpoints are supported. Even if you specify UnifiedEndpoint, it does not take effect.</notice>

<notice>The UnifiedEndpoint parameter is currently available only to whitelisted users. If a non-whitelisted user specifies this parameter, an invocation error is returned. To apply for the permissions, submit a ticket.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
创建云原生双可用区读写分离实例时，使用的连接地址类型。不显式传该参数时，值默认为AzIndependentEndpoint。

AzIndependentEndpoint : 默认值。可用区独立连接地址。主、备可用区分别提供独立连接地址，可通过不同的连接地址实现可用区就近访问。
UnifiedEndpoint : 统一连接地址。提供统一的连接地址，通过该地址同时访问到主备可用区的节点，但会出现跨可用区访问。

<notice>该参数仅适用于云原生双可用区读写分离实例。对于其他类型实例，仅支持可用区独立连接地址，即使传入UnifiedEndpoint也不会真正生效。></notice>

<notice> UnifiedEndpoint 参数目前仅面向白名单用户开放。非白名单用户传入该参数将导致调用报错。如需开通使用权限，请提交工单申请加白。></notice>
parameters.name: instance_endpoint_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the maintenance window for the instance. Specify the time in the HH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. For example, if you want the maintenance window to start at 01:00 (UTC+8), set the value to `17:00Z`. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 18:00 (UTC), which is 02:00 (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 设置实例可维护时段的开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。例如，需要在北京时间凌晨1点开始，应设置为`17:00Z`。 若不设置，值默认为北京时间凌晨2:00，即UTC时间18:00
parameters.name: maintain_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the maintenance window for the instance. Specify the time in the HH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. For example, if you want the maintenance window to end at 02:00 (UTC+8), set the value to `18:00Z`. The interval between the start time and the end time must be at least 1 hour. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 22:00 (UTC), which is 06:00 (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 设置实例可维护时段的结束时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。例如，需要在北京时间凌晨2点结束，应设置为`18:00Z`。 开始时间和结束时间的间隔不能低于1小时。 若不设置，值默认为北京时间凌晨6:00，即UTC时间22:00
